Two ships went in, but no screen reached 4 from the critic, so this is only partly done. I shot and critic-scored screens 46, 52, 55, 56, 62 and 64. I did not re-shoot or critic-score 58, 63, 48, 49, 53 or 54 this run.

I shipped `cw-partylook4` and `cw-partylook5` (v31.46). Both passed preflight, and the gate's fixture checks and seed 4242 fingerprint passed on v31.46. Together they:
- brighten the card titles above the quiet grey sub-line;
- raise the "press any key" prompt to body size;
- put the X on the prompt line.

I cut no line of his, so there is no Q8 reason to log.

Critic scores on the after pictures (the before shots are in `12-r4-before`, the after shots in `12-r4-after2`):

| Screen | Score | Vs. before |
|---|---|---|
| 46 how to play | 3 | same |
| 52 run over | 3 | better |
| 55 run over scored | 3 | better |
| 56 tonight's best | 3 | same |
| 62 operator menu | 3 | better |
| 64 board | 2 | same |

The critic keeps repeating the same asks: a bigger prompt with a device glyph, 4 equal stat columns, a 56px "score" hero with a label above, a 16px minimum for labels, a darker scrim, and 56px header and 72px footer rows. Two ships did not lift any screen to 4, so under the stuck rule I stopped. I did not turn the prompt back into a button, since his any-key ruling stands.

Screen 64 is the weakest at 2: the card is small and almost empty, and it shows the raw seed code. The next ship I'd try there is to drop the seed code, set the sub-line at 16px, and left-align the empty state.

I logged the changes in `notes/ui/changes.md` and the run notes in `notes/12-ui-party-screens.md`. I did not update the Changes section of `notes/ui/index.html`.

TASK PARTIAL: no listed screen has reached a critic score of 4 (46, 52, 55, 56 and 62 sit at 3, 64 at 2). Screens 58, 63, 48, 49, 53 and 54 were not re-shot this run. Screen 64 is next, then the repeated critic asks above.
